summary: Carry the current canonical Karmic runtime into beta
details: Weights load into ordinary PyTorch allocations; the loader keeps only its scoped checkpoint-copy transport.
Block-FP8 linears and DeepSeek attention-output projections are prepared with a capacity plan, so intermediate live sizes reuse prepared kernels while serving.
Qwen QSA derives page alignment from the speculative ring and accepts more than four MTP draft tokens.
Adaptive speculative verification warms each captured shape before timing and alternates sample rounds on every worker.
